title: Validation of a Deep Learning Algorithm for Continuous, Real-Time Detection of Atrial Fibrillation Using a Wrist-Worn Device in an Ambulatory Environment
summary: The wearable system detected AF with 96.1% interval-level sensitivity and 98.1% specificity against continuous ECG reference during ambulatory monitoring. Prospective multicenter study; 117 enrolled, 111 analyzed, 91,857 simultaneous analyzable intervals against a 14-day ECG patch. Unanalyzable intervals, small AF-positive participant counts, short-episode sensitivity, subgroup size, and commercial affiliations constrain interpretation.
ai_technology: A photoplethysmography convolutional neural network detects AF continuously; a separate ECG rhythm classifier labels watch ECG episodes, with clinician review.
